unit.name: --u
unit.purpose: One pixel of the 1536px design; frontmatter px values are multiplied by it above 960px.

components.name: Email Button
components.description: The one action on the page: olive field, Castoro label, outline envelope.
components.html: Email Jay
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 34px; width: 374px; height: 78px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--olive, #394718); color: var(--on-olive, #f7f5ec); font-family: var(--serif, 'Castoro', Georgia, serif); font-size: 37px; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-cta svg { width: 42px; height: 31px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-cta:hover { background: var(--olive-deep, #2b3611); } .ds-cta:hover svg { transform: translateY(-3px) rotate(-4deg); } .ds-cta:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--olive, #394718); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Theme Switch
components.description: Pill track with a sliding olive knob; sun and moon outline icons. A button with role=switch.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 96px; height: 40px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--switch, #efeee6); color: var(--olive, #394718); cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 50px; height: 32px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--olive, #394718); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-switch span { position: relative; display: flex; } .ds-switch svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.6; } .ds-switch-sun { margin-left: 6px; color: var(--on-olive, #f7f5ec); } .ds-switch-moon svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } .ds-switch:hover::before { transform: translateX(38px); } .ds-switch:hover .ds-switch-sun { color: var(--olive, #394718); } .ds-switch:hover .ds-switch-moon { color: var(--on-olive, #f7f5ec); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--olive, #394718); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header links in Red Hat Text; a 1px underline draws in from the left on hover and focus.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 48px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Red Hat Text', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 22.5px; color: var(--ink, #1d1612); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; padding-block: 0.3em; background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 100% / 0 1px no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { background-size: 100% 1px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--olive, #394718); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Chapter Caption
components.description: Castoro italic caption centred under a square-cornered print; the underline grows from the centre on hover.
components.html: Forge Kitchen · in development
components.css: .ds-chapter { display: block; width: 474px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-chapter-print { display: block; aspect-ratio: 474 / 325; background: var(--band, #f5ece5); } .ds-chapter-caption { display: block; width: fit-content; margin: 8px auto 0; padding-bottom: 3px; font-family: var(--serif, 'Castoro', Georgia, serif); font-style: italic; font-size: 27px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--espresso, #3b1c09); background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 50% 100% / 0 1px no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chapter:hover .ds-chapter-caption, .ds-chapter:focus-visible .ds-chapter-caption { background-size: 100% 1px; }

components.name: Brand Band
components.description: Tinted strip that opens a brand section: title with a short olive bar, vertical hairline, short description.
components.html:
Forge Kitchen

Our first brand. Forge Kitchen is a line of kitchen and tabletop goods in development.
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 160px; padding: 20px 44px 36px; background: var(--band, #f5ece5); } .ds-band-title { position: relative; flex: none; margin: 0; padding-bottom: 15px; font-family: var(--serif, 'Castoro', Georgia, serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 71px; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--espresso, #3b1c09); } .ds-band-title::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 112px; height: 6px; background: var(--olive, #394718); } .ds-band-rule { align-self: stretch; flex: none; width: 1px; margin: 8px 48px 10px 51px; background: var(--rule-strong, #8f8279); } .ds-band-text { max-width: 690px; margin: 0; font-family: var(--sans, 'Red Hat Text', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.26; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--ink, #1d1612); }

components.name: Ledger
components.description: Facts as a definition list on hairlines: soft-ink label above a Castoro value.
components.css: .ds-ledger { margin: 0; width: 420px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #ddd5cd); } .ds-ledger > div { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding-block: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #ddd5cd); } .ds-ledger dt { font-family: var(--sans, 'Red Hat Text', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--ink-soft, #5c5047); } .ds-ledger dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--serif, 'Castoro', Georgia, serif); font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--espresso, #3b1c09); }

components.name: Contact Mail Link
components.description: The email address as a Castoro link on the olive contact band; underline thickens and the arrow nudges on hover.
components.html: jayheo@atelier-jw.com
components.css: .ds-contact { padding: 40px 44px; background: #394718; color: #f7f5ec; } .ds-mail { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3em; padding-bottom: 6px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--serif, 'Castoro', Georgia, serif); font-size: 46px; line-height: 1.15; background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 100% / 100% 1px no-repeat; transition: background-size 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-mail svg { width: 0.72em; height: 0.72em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.5; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-mail:hover { background-size: 100% 3px; } .ds-mail:hover svg { transform: translate(0.12em, -0.12em); } .ds-mail:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f7f5ec; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a bakery counter seen in soft window light: a flour-white ground, espresso-brown lettering, warm hairlines, and photographs of cakes, cast iron, linen and marble hung like prints with square corners. It is a familiar, clean, premium-homeware arrangement, chosen over louder graphic directions; the craft sits in proportion, type and light, not in ornament.

Density is generous and calm. One sentence spans the full width, three equal photographs follow it, and every later section is a ruled, two-voice composition: a Castoro headline or italic line against Red Hat Text reading copy. Facts are set as ledgers on hairlines because the company has facts, not products, to show.

The system is authored twice. Light is flour and espresso; dark is a roasted brown ground with cream lettering, and olive flips from a deep field to a pale one so the action keeps its contrast. Photographs are AI-generated illustrations of mood and material and are labelled as illustrative wherever they could be read as product or place.
keyCharacteristics: Flour ground, espresso headlines, one olive that belongs to the action and the closing band.
Castoro for everything that is said aloud (headlines, italic captions, values); Red Hat Text for everything that is read.
Square-cornered photographs; the only curves are the button (7px) and the pill switch.
Flat: no shadows anywhere. Depth is tone and hairline.
One proportional unit above 960px: the whole 1536px composition scales down together.
Light and dark themes are both first-class.

rules.name: The Olive Is Spoken For Rule
rules.body: Olive fills only the action (the Email button, the switch knob) and the closing contact band; elsewhere it appears as a line or mark (leaf mark, title bar, focus ring), never as body text or a second coloured field.

rules.name: The Band Stays Dark Rule
rules.body: In the dark theme olive becomes pale so the button reads on a roasted ground, but the contact band does not follow it: it stays deep olive (`contact-band-dark`) with cream text (`on-contact-dark`, `on-contact-soft-dark`). The closing band is a dark olive field in both themes.

rules.name: The Dimmed Print Rule
rules.body: Photographs are never swapped per theme. In dark they are dimmed to 90% brightness, and the linen strip drops to 50% opacity.

rules.name: The Spoken and Read Rule
rules.body: Castoro carries what the company says in its own voice: headlines, italic lines and captions, names, ledger values, the button and the email address. Red Hat Text carries what is read: paragraphs, navigation, facts, labels.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Everything is weight 400. Emphasis is a change of family, size or italic.

rules.name: The Italic Is a Caption Rule
rules.body: Castoro italic appears only on photo captions and the single brand line. Headlines stay upright.

rules.name: The Shrink, Don't Reflow Rule
rules.body: Between 961px and 1536px nothing rearranges. New desktop dimensions are written as `calc(n * var(--u))`, with a rem clamp only on text small enough to become unreadable.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone or a 1px rule. A shadow would be the first one in the system.

rules.name: The Print Rule
rules.body: A photograph is a print: square corners, no border, no radius, no overlay text. Its caption sits beneath it.

dos: Do write desktop dimensions as `calc(n * var(--u))` so new elements scale with the rest of the 1536px composition, and give them fixed or clamp values inside the 960px breakpoint.
Do author every colour in both themes, using the custom properties; check the dark theme whenever olive is involved, because it inverts from a deep field to a pale one.
Do keep photographs square-cornered, in one of the existing proportions (474:325, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9), with a real `alt` and explicit width and height.
Do label any image that could read as a product or a location as illustrative, in a label-size figcaption.
Do set facts as ledger rows on hairlines, label above value.
Do put styles in `styles.css`; the content security policy blocks inline `style` attributes and third-party fonts and stylesheets.
Do write asset URLs in `styles.css` from the repository root (`assets/fonts/...`); the deploy script rewrites them.
Do keep the 2px olive focus outline with its 3px offset, and the cream version on olive.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour or a second coloured field; olive is the only chromatic voice and it is spoken for.
Don't use olive for body text or decorative fills.
Don't add shadows, blurs, gradients over text, or rounded corners on photographs.
Don't use bold; every style is weight 400.
Don't set headlines in italic or reading text in Castoro.
Don't load fonts from a third-party host or add a third family.
Don't swap photographs per theme; dim them.
Don't present an illustrative image as an actual Forge Kitchen product or an actual café.
Don't animate on a loop or re-trigger entrances; prints are hung once.
